name: GD Control
description: A mobile-friendly Geometry Dash mod menu with No-Clip, Speedhack, local icon unlock, Practice Music Sync, Auto Clicker, TPS Bypass and FPS Bypass.

noclip-enabled.name: No-Clip
noclip-enabled.description: Suppresses normal player deaths for both players. Anticheat spikes and level completion still use the original game logic.

speed-multiplier.name: Speedhack
speed-multiplier.description: Scales gameplay time and FMOD master pitch together.

unlock-icons.name: Unlock Icons
unlock-icons.description: Locally treats every icon as unlocked. Does not write unlocks to your RobTop account.

unlock-practice-music.name: Unlock Practice Music
unlock-practice-music.description: Locally unlocks the Practice Music Sync shop requirement. Enable Practice Music Sync in the in-level pause settings.
